nodes.label: Bounded review diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Retain scalar timings and explicit incomplete status without private prompts or altered decisions.

nodes.label: Source-blind relationship critique
nodes.rationale: Check exact quotations and grounded entities before accepting memory groupings; semantic calibration remains imperfect.

nodes.label: Original-source memory threads
nodes.rationale: Reviewed threads retain original wording, questions and dates rather than generated factual recaps.

nodes.label: Correction-linked snapshot retention
nodes.rationale: At most 100 threads and 800 original snapshots; corrections and forgetting invalidate dependent provenance.

nodes.label: Decision-relevant inquiry gaps
nodes.rationale: Questions identify a supplied gap, useful decision and distinct conditional next steps; no gap permits silence.

nodes.label: Semantic gap suppression
nodes.rationale: A bounded 200-job history suppresses repeated semantic versions while preserving 45-minute and three-per-day interruption limits.

nodes.label: Lexical original-source retrieval
nodes.rationale: Rank canonical originals and paired questions; exclude generated summaries, superseded sources and remote private archives.

nodes.label: Request-local embedding fallback
nodes.rationale: Explicit recall may score locally cached embeddings after lexical abstention; vectors do not persist and measured paraphrase failures remain.

nodes.label: Independent controller readback
nodes.rationale: After accepted audio or mode mutations, fresh readback classifies verified, failed or unknown without automatically retrying actions.

nodes.label: Bounded outcome failure history
nodes.rationale: SQLite receipts and consecutive failure summaries inform local reasoning without proving source-task completion or granting tool authority.

nodes.label: Grounded semantic referent check
nodes.rationale: One local check must ground every unmatched query term in exact original source spans within the shared two-second recall budget.

nodes.label: Exact rescheduling target recovery
nodes.rationale: Recover only an unambiguous explicit to-date target from a verified correction quote, anchored to its original receipt.

nodes.label: Saved commitment topic reference
nodes.rationale: Chat and voice share one explicitly selected current commitment using existing reference-context storage and a 15-minute token.

nodes.label: Transactional topic fencing
nodes.rationale: Validate token, exact temporal revision, forget epoch and latest local request before answering; references authorize no actions.

nodes.label: Whole-date affirmative wrappers
nodes.rationale: Strip only supported anchored prefixes and require the entire remaining original span to resolve as one definite date.

nodes.label: Retained inquiry provenance
nodes.rationale: Date wrappers require an existing offered inquiry, current gap and epoch plus independent critique and transactional validation.

nodes.label: Scoped temporal-only review prompt
nodes.rationale: Compact only fully linked date-answer evidence while retaining original validation snapshots and independent critique.

nodes.label: Unresolved cold inference timeout
nodes.rationale: The measured candidate improves prompt size and warm review time but does not resolve cold first-inference timeout.

nodes.label: Single-word synonym mapping probe
nodes.rationale: A disposable probe maps every missing query term to an exact source token; complete synonym-only output is required.

nodes.label: Rejected isolated-word variants
nodes.rationale: Both variants confused object identities and were rejected; neither was wired into production.

nodes.label: Inquiry-linked date answer
nodes.rationale: Retain inquiry ID, exact question, original answer and receipt with source fingerprints and one current undated target.

nodes.label: Guarded temporal revision
nodes.rationale: Recheck inquiry and target inside the save transaction; missing provenance cannot revise a commitment and legacy links are not backfilled.

nodes.label: Local clarification ledger
nodes.rationale: Record issued questions, offered commitment versions, answers and forget epoch independently of autonomous inquiry.

nodes.label: Shared laptop clarification context
nodes.rationale: Typed chat and voice share local provenance while Telegram and unrelated turns cannot consume or preserve it.

nodes.label: Exact-span compact concept mapping
nodes.rationale: The hypothesis maps every missing concept to an exact source equivalent without additional calls or changed thresholds.

nodes.label: Rejected wrong-object recall candidate
nodes.rationale: The candidate accepted a lantern as a torch and was rejected; production was restored and the candidate retained only as an explicit disposable probe.

nodes.label: Named correction candidate priority
nodes.rationale: Prefer at most three newest explicit named rescheduling reports and current targets without treating them as accepted changes.

nodes.label: Same-weekday temporal uncertainty
nodes.rationale: A bare weekday matching receipt weekday remains unresolved instead of inventing today or next week; inquiry timing still applies.

nodes.label: Complete-term lexical support
nodes.rationale: Require all normalized content terms; similarity cannot override partially unsupported overlap, intentionally sacrificing some recall.

nodes.label: Verified quote date recovery
nodes.rationale: Recover one unambiguous calendar span from an exact verified source quote while retaining receipt anchoring, validation and independent critique.

nodes.label: Original surface query words
nodes.rationale: Keep deterministic normalization for overlap but send actual case-folded query words to the model and output enum.

nodes.label: Conservative production referent gate
nodes.rationale: Preserve complete concept coverage, exact spans, meaning checks and existing resource bounds; rejected synonym experiments remain excluded.

nodes.label: Native configuration editor
nodes.rationale: A four-tab Tkinter HTTP client edits contacts, routines, projects and modes with drafts, validation and offline feedback.

nodes.label: Atomic revision-protected configuration
nodes.rationale: Backend-owned validated mutations reject stale drafts and preserve broken files; editing never executes configured actions.

nodes.label: Resident taskbar control window
nodes.rationale: A native Tkinter taskbar panel uses existing tray and hotkey controllers with standard shortcut identity.

nodes.label: Owned backend lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Start and restart run off the UI thread; quitting closes only an owned backend and duplicate launch restores the existing panel.

nodes.label: One-shot normal startup activation
nodes.rationale: Normal startup requests the backend once; explicit Stop keeps the widget resident without idle restarts.

nodes.label: FRIDAY-specific health identity
nodes.rationale: Health must identify FRIDAY rather than accept an unrelated HTTP 200; native controls and forms retain validation.

nodes.label: Application-owned taskbar child
nodes.rationale: Use a native WS_CHILD in measured free Shell_TrayWnd space, reconnecting after replacement without Explorer injection.

nodes.label: Nonblocking shell geometry safeguards
nodes.rationale: Match DPI, keep the host message thread free of I/O, hide when safe geometry is unavailable and preserve explicit Stop semantics.

nodes.label: Durable ordered Telegram inbox
nodes.rationale: Persist received updates before acknowledgement; replay unseen work in order but never automatically replay interrupted unknown outcomes.

nodes.label: Message-scoped confirmation bypass
nodes.rationale: The /! prefix bypasses confirmation for one authenticated owner-private-chat message while remote isolation and offline confirmation ordering remain.

nodes.label: Text-first local screen interpretation
nodes.rationale: Use a killable active-window UIA reader and HWND capture, then eligible installed local text or vision models without cloud fallback.

nodes.label: Capture and privacy fences
nodes.rationale: Visible badge and heartbeat gate capture; private windows, pause and forgetting block raw screen persistence and remote context.

nodes.label: Revision-protected college catalogs
nodes.rationale: College services own typed validation and shared atomic mutation; HTTP edits carry revisions and stale writes return 409.

nodes.label: Consent-bound upload preview
nodes.rationale: Validate bounded uploads, use explicit fixed-provider vision consent and require reviewed rows/mode/revision hashes before guarded publication.

nodes.label: Observed activity exposure learning
nodes.rationale: Background observations extend exposures and bounded daily aggregates; repetition establishes recurrence rather than preferences or completion.

nodes.label: Private local activity context
nodes.rationale: Relevant activity informs local chat and voice only, with pause/forget fences, local generation and no cloud or shared-history copies.
